title: Sending a Gift to a Different Country

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

questions.evidence: I want to send a parcel to my aunt overseas.
questions.explanation: Jia 说收件人是她在海外的一位 aunt（可能是姑妈、姨妈、伯母、婶婶或舅妈等），具体关系未说明。

options: A glass cup and a card.
A small wooden bowl and a letter.
answers: A small wooden bowl and a letter.

questions.explanation: 对话说礼物是一只小木碗和一封信。

questions.evidence: Use cardboard that is strong enough, and wrap the bowl in soft paper.
questions.explanation: Sam 建议用软纸包裹木碗。

questions.explanation: 这是本虚构例子中的基本费用，金额为十八美元。

questions.prompt: What extra form is needed for the overseas shipment?
questions.evidence: An overseas shipment also needs a declaration.
questions.explanation: 该海外寄送例子需要申报表。

options: The number on the paper slip.
answers: The number on the paper slip.

questions.explanation: 计划在周二发送，而到达约需两周。

instructions: Listen to the conversation before reading the transcript and answer independently. After submitting, check the transcript and reasons for any errors.
transcript:
Jia: I want to send a parcel to my aunt overseas. Her birthday is next month, so there is enough time to prepare it. The gift is a small wooden bowl and a letter. I have a large envelope for the letter, but I think the bowl needs a box.
Sam: Yes. Use cardboard that is strong enough, and wrap the bowl in soft paper. A sturdy container will help. It is not glass, but it could still be damaged. Put tape across the top to seal the box.
Jia: I have written the recipient's name and street address. Is the zip code required for this country?
Sam: The fictional post office guide says to include the local code if you have it. Please confirm the code with your aunt before you leave. Your message can also tell her when the delivery may arrive.
Jia: I checked it this morning. The code ends in seven. The distance is long, so I want to understand the fee.
Sam: For this example, the clerk says the basic fee is eighteen dollars. An overseas shipment also needs a declaration. List the bowl and the letter, and be honest about what is inside.
Jia: Should I put a stamp on the box?
Sam: The clerk will print an official postage label after payment. Keep the paper slip as proof. It has a number you can use to trace the parcel.
Jia: Does my aunt need to provide a signature?
Sam: Not with the option we chose. There is a separate choice with insurance, but we are not buying it today. The clerk plans to dispatch the shipment on Tuesday, and your aunt may receive it in about two weeks.
Jia: Good. I will post it tomorrow and send her the number.
Sam: That sounds sensible. Our mail guide is only an example; the actual office can explain its own rules.
